  tail: Changed `save_report()` in `report.py` to use an atomic write pattern for crash safety. Instead of writing directly to the target file, it now: | 1. Writes to a temporary file in the same directory via `tempfile.mkstemp()` | 2. Uses `os.replace()` to atomically rename the temp file to the target path | 3. Cleans up the temp file on any failure | This ensures the existing report is never damaged — it's either the old complete version or the new complete version, never truncated. The test suite passes.
